acquisition.comparability: Artifact byte counts are exact and comparable; acquisition lower bounds differ in measurement coverage, common intake and raw/display transforms. Graph operation counts are not prose shell-command counts. No input-efficiency ranking follows.

practical_recommendation: Use the representation-derived role contexts as a viable compact drafting route for these selected scenarios, preserving qualified provenance and source re-entry on insufficiency/staleness. Keep typed map meaning visible and treat the maps as optional navigation/audit material, not a compulsory payload in every recipient. Retain prose-first as a valid route. Neither route has established general or operational superiority.
